endorsements.name: Sam Thomas
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-1230
endorsements.description: This vulnerability allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Samsung Galaxy S21 prior to 4.5.40.5 phones. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of redirections. An attacker can force a redirection to a site that serves malicious content. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-15918.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.0, 3.9)

endorsements.name: Sam Thomas
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-22817
endorsements.description: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a rogue server on the local network to modify its URL using another DNS address to point back to the loopback adapter. This could then allow the URL to exploit other vulnerabilities on the local server. This was addressed by fixing DNS addresses that refer to loopback. This issue affects My Cloud OS 5 devices before 5.27.161, My Cloud Home, My Cloud Home Duo and SanDisk ibi devices before 9.5.1-104.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.5)
